en: A slow connection recovers within seconds instead of staying half a second behind: AnyRemote no longer floods a slow link with full pictures after losses.
Video quality also lowers when the network starts queuing, before frames get lost.
A stuck video encoder on the other Mac no longer freezes a window: it restarts, and falls back to software encoding if needed.
zh-Hans: 网络慢时几秒内就能恢复，不会再一直落后半秒：丢帧后不再用一张张完整画面把慢速链路堵死。
网络开始排队时也会降低画质，不必等到丢帧。
对方 Mac 的视频编码器卡住时，窗口不会再冻住：会重新启动编码器，必要时改用软件编码。
